origin: Hodgdon Reloading Manual 2024 and Western Powders Handloading Guide 8.0 (loads, velocities, PSI pressures; tools/loaddata)
descr: Burn rate Ba fitted to 320 start and maximum loads of the manufacturer's published load data (22 cartridges), velocity error 3.6 % rms, pressure error 12 % rms (published pressures). Not published and therefore only typical or chosen values: Qex (the type (single/double base) is not published, double-base assumed because it fits the velocities better), k, material density pc, bulk density pcd, and the form function (a0, z1, z2: the data hardly determine it). Check every load against the manufacturer's current load data.
